1. Introduction
The Adversarial Multi Armed Bandit(MAB) problem proceeds as a sequential game of T rounds
between a player and an adversary. In each round t = 1, . . . , T , the player selects a distribution pt
over the n-arms and the adversary selects a loss vector lt belonging to some set L ⊆ Rn . An action
it is sampled from pt and the player observes the loss lt (it ). The (expected) regret of the player is:
